# Security Policy

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately so we can address it before public disclosure.

Preferred reporting options:

- Open a private security report via GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/owners/microla/security/advisories (or use the repository's **Security** tab)
- Email security@microla.dev with details (replace with your preferred contact address)

Please include:

- Affected versions/components
- Detailed steps to reproduce
- Any exploit proof-of-concept or test code

We will respond as quickly as possible and publish a coordinated disclosure when fixed.
